rationale: Explicit goals/non-goals dichotomy in section 1.1/1.2. Non-goals are concrete and verifiable (e.g., 'Not a source code fixer', 'Not a real-time monitor'). No fail_if conditions triggered.

evidence_refs.quote: Not a source code fixer — 评估产出评分卡 + 修复建议，不生成 patch
Not a replacement for human review — 人类在 loop 中作为最终仲裁
Not a real-time monitor — 是批/触发型，不做 metrics dashboard
Not a training/eval benchmark — 不读训练数据、不调权重
Not opinionated on aesthetics — 美学/品味/灵感等无客观证据的领域不进入 v1 rubric
